_meta.description: Guide register. Eight question-shaped guides ship at launch: the four brief hypotheses plus four spec-backed topics in the same shape. Every guide is written to VOICE.md, ends at the verified three, and satisfies the internal-linking rule (comparison, category page, two sibling guides). Titles are working titles, not claims about search volume (evidence rule D-08).
_meta.fact_rule: A guide may state a product fact only with its product register citation. Nothing else about products is claimed.
